behavior: Increase available stock for a product and publish an inventory integration event when successful.
repository: IInventoryItemDomainRepository for load plus IInventoryStockOutbox for atomic state/event commit
domainModelNotes: InventoryItem is looked up by ProductId in the application layer.
If no inventory item exists, the current implementation returns InventoryItemNotFound.
constructorPostconditions: Current stock is increased by the requested quantity.
IInventoryStockOutbox atomically updates stock and inserts ProductStockIncreasedIntegrationEvent with a UUID v7 message ID and ProductId N partition key.
The update matches the expected pre-mutation stock and fails closed on a concurrent change.
qualityUplift: Current aggregate permits non-positive increase values; reconstruction must reject them without side effects.
